text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mubarak tells university students in open forum discussion that U.S. aid will not put pressure on Egypt's decision-making, that it will not continue forever and that Egypt will not starve without it. President also says that U.S. secretary of state's affirmation of the principle of land for peace is encouraging and that making progress towards resolving the problem will guarantee security.
- State authorities begin to implement Mubarak's call to ban smoking.
- Justice Ministry has finished putting together draft law to fight thuggery. Any acts of thuggery that result in death will be punished by execution.
- Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi will visit Egypt within next 48 hours.
